sample.question:
The synchronized front, right, and top panels show labeled beacons in a 6x6x6 coordinate cube. Coordinates are (x,y,z), each from 0 to 5. Rotation Z+ maps (x,y,z) to (5-y,x,z); rotation X+ maps it to (x,5-z,y).
Which pair occupies the same cell in the FRONT projection because only their y-coordinates differ?
A. B & C
B. A & B
C. A & C
D. A & D
E. A & E
F. A & F
sample.analysis: Front projection keeps (x,z) and collapses y. A is at (4, 5, 2); B is at (4, 4, 2). Their (x,z) values match, so the answer is B.
